turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Alex calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent

turns.text: Yes, is my cell.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me just pull up account. One please.

turns.text: Okay.

turns.text: I want to make a complaint about how many times you call.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll make a note on the file so the hardship team can review your situation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You should hear from them within a few business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'll try to pay $163 the 28th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $163.02 on August 28. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.text: you be paying through the app or online banking?

turns.text: Perfect.

turns.text: Before I transfer you, we can also set up a payment plan.

turns.speaker: agent
